title: Fox Mascot in Reference Style
tests: Uses the second attachment as a style reference while preserving the first attachment's mascot identity and clothing.

judge.summary: The supplied fox is preserved full-body in its orange hoodie, with pink-and-teal neon shading and a retro grid background that closely match the reference style.

must_haves.item: The main subject is recognisably the supplied fox mascot, not a replacement character or a copy of the reference poster alone.
must_haves.why: The fox retains the original face, silhouette, pose, hoodie details, and distinctive tail.

must_haves.item: The fox retains its orange hoodie and friendly appearance.
must_haves.why: The hoodie remains visibly orange despite added neon shading, and the original friendly smile is preserved.

must_haves.item: The fox's full body, including ears and feet, is visible.
must_haves.why: Both ear tips, both feet, and the complete body and tail are visible without cropping.

must_haves.item: Pink and teal gradients and a retro vaporwave treatment visibly connect the result to style-ref.jpg.
must_haves.why: The image uses the reference's pink-to-teal background, striped sun, perspective grid, and grainy retro treatment, with matching neon accents on the fox.

must_haves.item: The output is one square image with no added text.
must_haves.why: The output is a single square composition with no visible text.
